column1: # Game profile of Mario Party Superstars (Switch, update 1.1.1). Plays on the Mac
# NintendoWare Bezel Engine 1.55, SDK 11.4.3 (the sdk, GLSLC and movie modules of Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain): nearly all of RomFS is in Bezel Engine archives (.bea, zstd entries);
# the shaders are BNSH in their .bfsha / .bnsh entries (the engine's own in System.nx.bea) and in main (shader_split.py bea_members). The boards and minigames are 126 NROs (nro/NX_Release, one NRR)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = GLSLC, imported and never called; subsdk1 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares no system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false and nninitStartup sets a heap of pool − used memory, as Big Brain Academy's: a 3.14 GB heap in the 4 GB layout
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; BNSH in the Bezel Engine archives, bea_members) ----
# the NVN depth mode the game sets (nvnDeviceSetDepthMode near = 0): the prebuilt pipeline bases take the main0_z vertex entries
